name: leetcode-cph-receiver
description: Capture LeetCode problems, manage test cases in the sidebar, generate AI test scaffolds, and sync code back to the browser.

leetcodeCph.outputDirectory.description: Folder inside the current workspace where each captured problem gets a title-named directory containing solution.<ext>, main.<ext>, and a .leetcode_cph state folder.

leetcodeCph.openSolutionAfterCapture.description: Open the saved solution file after a capture arrives.

leetcodeCph.ai.provider.description: AI provider used to generate the local testcase scaffold. Its API key is stored only in VS Code SecretStorage.

leetcodeCph.ai.model.description: Optional model name for the selected AI provider. Leave empty to use the extension default.
